text:
rowan: Quick note  my friend Dr. Ana is dropping by at 3pm with a small metal sculpture for a photo shoot and a padded envelope. Can we prepare a guest badge and a safe stand near the north atrium? Also might be a delivery earlier today for me  can you hold it?
front-desk: No problem. Guests get a day badge and must sign in. North atrium has a low plinth we can reserve (no outlet). Packages are usually held in locker E1. What name for the badge?
rowan: Badge under 'Ana Torres'. Delivery is likely addressed to Rowan Cole. If the package arrives, please mark "Do not stack"  sculpture is delicate.
reception-bot: Guest badge print queued for "Ana Torres" at 14:46. Badge ID: G-5122.
mira: Heads-up  if the sculpture has sharp edges please leave it on the plinth mat not on chairs. I'll be nearby to assist with the shoot.
dennis: Mailroom noted a large box for Rowan Cole labeled "fragile - glass" that arrived at 13:30. Placed in locker E1. No sign of damage but the box looked taller than it should be.
mailroom: Update: earlier someone (intern) grabbed a different tall box from E1 thinking it was theirs. We tracked them down and swapped items back. The correct parcel for Rowan is now in E1 with sticker "Do not stack".
rowan: Oh wow thanks for catching that. Can you also add a "sculpture" note so it doesn't get moved?
front-desk: Added sticky note "Sculpture - do not move" and reserved plinth. Mat placed. We'll hand over the nursing key if needed (just kidding) :smile:
reception-bot: Guest checked in at 15:01. Badge handed to Ana Torres. Parcel status: in locker E1, sticky notes attached. Called x3001.
mira: Plinth prepped and mat laid. Ana's here and doing a quick setup. Please avoid the north atrium walkway for 15-15:30.
rowan: Thanks everyone! The studio shots should be quick. I'll collect the parcel after the shoot.
mailroom: Parcel picked up by Rowan at 15:42. Closing loop  all accounted for.
dennis: Great teamwork :clap:
